name: Trainwreck
summary: **Trainwreck** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] that originated near Arcata, in Humboldt County, California, with accounts placing its creation anywhere from the mid-1970s to the late 1980s. A cross of [[mexican-sativa|Mexican Sativa]], [[thai|Thai]], and [[afghani|Afghani]] landraces, it takes its name from a local train-derailment legend. Some sources instead describe it as a cross of [[northern-lights|Northern Lights]] and Mexican sativa.
